answer_1.quote: We use the data of WMT23 Metrics Shared Task which has been annotated with MQM and ESA. ... We hire 21 annotators that are professional translators and native in the target language, German.
answer_1.outputs: error spans with severity labels (minor/major) and a final translation quality score (0-100)

answer_4.quote: The annotators manually assign a final score on the scale from 0% to 100% (not with AI) ranging from "no meaning preserved" to "perfect". ... The ESA protocol asks the annotators to provide only the error severity (not its type) but also a final translation score.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators mark error spans with severity (minor or major) and then assign a final translation quality score from 0 to 100.
